user.title: Fitness (fitbridge)
user.description: Adds the Fitness page to the sidebar. It reads fitbridge's scores through the MQTT integration, which must be set up first.

init.title: Who is who
init.description: Pick the fitbridge person for each Home Assistant user. Users set to Nobody see the household read-only.

shoes.title: Shoes
shoes.description: Pick each person's running shoes from Endurain. Shoes retired in Endurain don't show on the page.

limits.title: Replace at
limits.description: The distance at which each shoe should be replaced. The page warns from 90%.

steps.title: Step sensors
steps.description: Pick each person's daily steps sensor, for example from the phone's companion app. Leave it empty for no steps.

abort.waiting_for_fitbridge: Waiting for fitbridge: no scores have arrived over MQTT yet. Try again once fitbridge has published.
